pattern: に先駆けて（にさきがけて）
purpose: Act ahead of others or before a larger event begins.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N + に先駆けて; N + に先駆ける + N
We unveiled the prototype ahead of the nationwide launch.
We adopted the new material before other companies.
We observed a moment of silence before the opening.
formation: N + に先駆けて; N + に先駆ける + N
restrictions: Often stresses a pioneering step or advance launch.
mistake: It implies precedence, not simply any unrelated earlier time.
